title: Sign in as a buyer
desc: Buyers sign in with the Buyer organisation card. New buyers use 'Register as a buyer — free'. Forgot password also has a Buyer option.

title: Register as a buyer — free
desc: Name, email, mobile, country and city are required; state, address, ZIP and organisation are optional. Country, state, city and phone code come from the PMC masters. The buyer confirms their email, then PMC verifies the account before bidding and buying unlock.

title: Buyer dashboard
desc: Left sidebar, top header with notification bell and avatar menu, and footer. Tiles show active bids and offers, orders to pay, orders in delivery, wins and unread notifications.

title: Avatar menu
desc: Edit profile, change the profile photo, change password and sign out.

title: Watchlist
desc: Products the buyer saved with the ♡ Save button. For auctions a reminder (bell + email) is sent about an hour before closing.

title: Bids & auctions
desc: Every bid and offer with its live status: Leading, Outbid, Won, Lost; offers show Open, Accepted or Declined.
actions: Open the product to raise a bid

title: Purchases & deliveries
desc: Won and bought items. Pay securely for items awaiting payment, follow the delivery status set by the seller and confirm 'I received it'.

title: Payments & refunds
desc: Every payment made and any refund or payout back to the buyer.

title: Notifications
desc: Outbid alerts, closing reminders, wins, accepted offers, payments and deliveries. Important ones are also emailed.

title: My team
desc: The organisation's main buyer invites colleagues; every invite is approved by PMC before the colleague can sign in. Removing a colleague stops access at once.

title: Profile & security
desc: Masters-backed profile (country, state, city, phone code) and password change.

title: Marketplace with Save buttons
desc: Signed-in buyers see ♡ Save on every product card and their name menu in the site header.
actions: Open a product to bid, offer or buy

title: Buyer applications, direct add & team invites
desc: Approve self-registered buyers (after email confirmation) and applications; add a buyer directly (sign-in emailed); approve team invites from buyer organisations; send or resend buyer sign-ins.

title: Marketplace approvals (bulk)
desc: Pending supplier listings can be ticked and approved or rejected together, with one note and an optional fee waiver.

title: Sell products — sales & delivery
desc: Sold items show the buyer, amount, PMC fee, your net amount, payment and payout status. For paid orders mark Dispatched and Delivered (with a tracking note); the buyer is notified.
